tailored:
Dear Lucid Labs team,

What drew me to this role is the gap you describe between a convincing demo and a system a department trusts daily — that is exactly the work I enjoy most. On my project TalentHiv, I built an AI-driven candidate screening system end to end: a FastAPI backend with structured REST design, PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations, and CV analysis powered by LangChain and Azure OpenAI — deployed to Azure App Service with Key Vault, not a local prototype. I implemented validation, error handling, and Pytest testing because a system that fails quietly is worse than one that fails loudly.

On VoiceHive Hotels I built a multilingual AI voice assistant with real-time STT/TTS, GPT-4 conversation handling, and a Docker/Kubernetes architecture designed deliberately for cost-efficient, scalable operation. I also built the production interfaces around these systems in Next.js, React and TypeScript, including GDPR compliance features such as data export and deletion.

Before switching to software development, I spent 20 years leading operational teams of 50+ at Casino Cosmopol in a strictly regulated environment — structured documentation, escalation paths, and communicating complex issues to non-specialists were my daily work. I write things down so nobody has to chase me, and I raise blockers early.

I am an EU citizen able to work full-time, and my working language is English (native).

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your customer projects.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
